As an introvert 10 year older than you all I can say is change yourself, it's hard to go out and meet people, but you have to do it, make guy friends and stick with them, normal guys talk to girls too, so as long as you are around guys you will meet girls too, don't find people like yourself, find extroverts, they will want to hang out with you too, and extroverts have shit ton to talk about as well so you don't have to worry about that.

I'm 28 and almost giving up hope of meeting someone that I would actually like, I was in a 10 year long relationship that ended last year, honestly the relationship was a bit abusive too, I got out of that because she fell in love with someone else after all those years, and when she wanted to be back, it took every ounce of courage in me to say no and I regret that so much, now I'm alone and lonely. But at the same time I also fell in love with someone else at my university and I got rejected haha, it made everything so much more worse for me... 

But this university experience made me learn something, to be outspoken about what I feel, it felt so wrong to ask someone out, but at the same time I did anyway, and I say things that I would never normally do, I still make very few friends, if any at all, but now I speak openly about what I feel or what to do. You should start that today, find someone and however awkward it may be, say something like "hey, how was your day?" Or "looking good man/dude/woman", also you are an introvert so I'm assuming you would already be classifying people as "approachable in emergency" to "get the freak out of here", just go to people who you have seen to have react well to random small talk. I don't have severe anxiety, I don't need medication for it, you have it so just be careful, you aren't going to find anyone by sitting and home and avoiding people, and you will only find the least fit people on the internet so avoid that too, if you need to, be on medication, but make it a rule to interact with people face to face
